title: Derivation of Conical Pendulum Revolution Period
assumptions: Light inextensible string of length L
Constant angular speed omega in horizontal circle of radius R = L sin(theta)
starting_principles: Horizontal centripetal force T sin(theta) = m omega^2 R

ordered_steps.explanation: Write vertical and horizontal dynamical equations for string tension T.
Solve for angular velocity omega from the horizontal equation.
Compute the revolution period T = 2 pi / omega.

limiting_cases: As theta -> 0 (small oscillations), period approaches simple pendulum 2 pi sqrt(L/g)
claim_traces: HCV1 Ch 7 p. 116; UP Ch 5 p. 180
